calibration.method: Wiki markers and comments are review evidence only. They never overwrite model scores; every disagreement enters the cached LLM review queue.

formula.component: impact * absolute_magnitude_anchor * probability * scenario_availability * stage_condition * scope * cost
formula.overall: strongest role + up to 5 points from second role; roles are attack, defense, support, expedition, growth and mechanism
formula.note_zh: 总评以最强可用职责为基准，第二职责最多奖励 5 分；不会再用无关场景平均稀释专精防守或专精辅助角色。Wiki 新手标记只进入差异审计，不直接改写评分。
